BillHeading.Sponsors: House Health Care & Wellness (originally sponsored by Representatives Cody, Riccelli, Bateman, Macri, Tharinger, and Pollet)
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning facility fees for audio-only telemedicine.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to facility fees for audio-only telemedicine; and adding a new section to chapter 70.41 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 70.41 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: A hospital that is an originating site or distant site for audio-only telemedicine may not charge a facility fee.
